details:
Nowhere in the Community Guidelines does it state anything about sexual activity itself, however it does prohibit publicly sharing the content (as you can see from the attachment).  I believe this needs to be updated seeing that one of the options for reporting a player is "behavior -> sexual."  Why is this reporting option there if the CG doesn't prohibit sexual behavior?

  The way the Community Guidelines is now implies that sexual activity even in public is perfectly acceptable, (such as lap dances, pole dances, full-blown sexual acts), so long as the avatars in question aren't nude or "inappropriate" (even though this is never enforced) and no one is "sharing it publicly."

  I believe the Community Guidelines should be updated to include the prohibiting of all forms of sexual activity mentioned above.  If not, people will continue to do these things in public without technically violating the CG.

  Not only that, but section 12: Prohibited Conduct is far too vague about sexualized avatars.  It says you cannot upload content that a "reasonable person" can deem to be objectionable, pornographic, indecent, inappropriate.  Well, what exactly would make a person "reasonable" or not?  When I report people for pole/lap dancing in public using blatantly sexual avatars, nothing is ever done about it, even with video proof.  This alone is what makes me question the CG about its stance on sexual "activity."
title: Community Guidelines vague about sexual activity.  Is it allowed or not?
